mechanism: Ginseng may induce CYP450 enzymes and phenobarbital is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer, potentially reducing ginseng levels and increasing phenobarbital metabolism; additionally, both agents may have additive CNS effects.
action: Monitor phenobarbital levels and seizure control; counsel patient to report increased seizure activity or ginseng use to prescriber; consider avoiding concurrent use or use with caution.
